div.div:
أَذٍ Experiencing, or suffering, [annoyance, molestation, harm, hurt, or] what is disagreeable, or hateful, or evil, (M, * K, * Msb,) in a great, or vehement, degree; (M, K;) applied to a man; (M, Msb;) as also ↓ أَذِىٌّ : (M, K:) and both signify the contr.; i. e. doing what is disagreeable, or hateful, or evil, in a great, or vehement, degree. (K.) ―
-b2- Also, applied to a camel, That will not remain still in one place, by reason of a natural disposition, not from pain, (El-Umawee, A'Obeyd, S, M, K,) nor disease; (K;) as also ↓ أَذىٌّ : (M:) fem. of the former أَذِيَةٌ; (El-Umawee &c.;) and of the latter ↓ أَذِيَّةٌ . (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
